integrity: The theorem is supported by an explicit derivative-ratio proof, algebraic discriminant analysis, exact root localization and standalone Python verification. Self-review only; independent audit was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact mathematical classification only for two simultaneous linearly routed Nash branches of respective integer shapes 2 and 3 with positive rates and positive mixing weights; no inference to observed catchments, translated rain events, nonlinearity, reservoir heterogeneity, or additional branches. Numerical checks supplement an analytical proof; original publication priority remains open.
title: Two sharp rate contrasts for bimodality in parallel two- and three-reservoir hydrographs
